map.averaging: equal AP per query, then equal average across ten tIoU thresholds
map.confidence_order: native submitted confidence, descending within each query
map.missing_prediction_policy: fail on missing qid; empty prediction contributes zero AP
map.implementation: compute_average_precision_detection from the experiment frozen native eval/utils.py
map.existing_qd_test_map_parity: all five saved native test mAP values match the newly computed all-positive mAP after rounding to two decimals

gmiou1.threshold_source: same existing full Seen validation thresholds
gmiou1.window_policy: first valid native submitted top-1; no duration-bound skipping

macro: equal average across all five splits per backbone, not pooled queries
bootstrap_ci: existing 500-draw CIs retained for Seen/Unseen AUROC and Gap only; new mAP and corrected-window G-mIoU CIs were not computed
